description: This PHP file defines the class `FormatWithNationality` within the `OrangeHRM` system. It implements the `ValueFormatter` interface to provide functionality for formatting entity values based on nationality. It interacts with the `NationalityService` to retrieve nationality data, specifically the name of the nationality based on an ID.

classes.name: FormatWithNationality
classes.description: A class that formats values by retrieving a nationality name based on a given ID, using the `NationalityService`.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the name of the nationality given an ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: getNationalityService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns an instance of `NationalityService`.
